QuestInfo.name: Rise of the Alliance
QuestInfo.0: What should the Resistance do about those that want to resurrect the Black Mage? Ask #p2152004#.
QuestInfo.1: The Resistance has met and decided to participate in the continental conference, led by Empress #p1101000#. They're not certain they can defeat the Black Mage, even with the other leaders of Maple World at their side, but they know they can't do it on their own. Bring word of the Resistance's official acceptance back to Empress #p1101000#.
QuestInfo.2: The Alliance would give you a chance to avenge #p2151005#, wouldn't it?

1.0: Welcome, honored member of the #m310000000#. I have been awaiting your answer anxiously.\r\n#L0##bWell, the wait is over. We're in!#l\n#k
1.1: Thank you for the answer that I've been hoping for.

yes.0: I welcome your decision. I'll see you at the meeting. We're expecting great results!
